screen.name: Name
screen.notKnownYet: Go.dot has not named this tablet yet
screen.foregroundRefused: Android refused to keep the link in the background: {problem}

tabs.cuesLater: The cue list comes in a later build.
tabs.runningLater: The running cues come in a later build.
tabs.surfaceLater: The surface comes in a later build.
tabs.mappingLater: The video mapping comes in a later build.
tabs.noMachine: No connection on screen: add one on the Connections tab.

header.notSentNoMachine: Not sent: no connection is linked
header.loadedAt: loaded at {time} · GO plays from here
header.loadedBefore: loaded from the top · GO plays it from its start

machines.title: Connections
machines.none: No connection yet. Type the address of the computer running Go.dot below.
machines.taken: Another connection in the list has this address and port.
machines.removeText: Its link closes and it leaves the list. Nothing changes on the computer itself.
machines.tooOld: This Go.dot cannot stream its state to a remote: update it to a build with the remote.

quit.keeps: Every machine is unlinked and the app closes. They stay in the list with their Linked switch: the next launch links them again.
quit.title: Quit the remote?
quit.explain: Every machine is unlinked, the app closes and stops running in the background. Nothing changes in Go.dot.

tablet.title: This tablet
tablet.name: Its name
tablet.nameSaid: Go.dot shows this name in Show settings > Network.

find.title: Find this tablet
find.explain: Go.dot's Show settings > Network has a Find button for this tablet: its screen and its camera light flash, it sounds its alarm - turned up if it was at nothing - and vibrates until it is touched.
find.notificationsOff: Notifications are off for this app: Go.dot cannot find the tablet while the app is in the background.
find.overLockOff: Android does not let the alarm open over the lock screen: a locked tablet will sound and vibrate, without the flashing screen.
find.allowOverLock: Allow it over the lock screen
find.channelDescription: The alarm Go.dot sounds to find this tablet.
find.notificationText: Swipe it away to stop the alarm.

link.tooOld: this Go.dot is too old for the remote

refusal.noClock: Audio disconnected - cues paused; waiting for the interface and clock.
refusal.paused: Paused - press Play to go on
refusal.ignoredPaused: {command} ignored: the show is paused - press Play to go on
refusal.setMany: node.setMany refused: {reason} at {where} - none of its values was written
refusal.goTooSoon: GO ignored: too soon after the last one (Show settings > Playback)
refusal.dohTooLate: Doh! ignored: the last GO is too long ago to take back (Show settings > Playback)
refusal.dohNothing: Doh! ignored: there is no GO it can take back
refusal.dohTrigger: Doh! ignored: a trigger fired after the last GO
refusal.dohTooSoon: Doh! ignored: pressed again too soon (Show settings > Playback)
refusal.flagNothing: Nothing flagged: no GO has fired a cue yet
refusal.flagGone: Nothing flagged: the cue the last GO fired has been deleted

notification.channelDescription: Keeps this tablet linked to Go.dot while the app is in the background.

mapping.noOutputs: This show has no video outputs. They are made in Go.dot, in Show settings > Video.
mapping.stale: Nothing can be changed until the link is live again.
mapping.lockedExplain: The show is locked: the warps, the grid and the zones' opacity and blend cannot be changed until it is unlocked. Identify and the grid on the projector still work.

identify.label: Identify
identify.on: The test pattern is on this projector
identify.off: Puts a white frame and a cross on this projector

projectorGrid.label: Grid
projectorGrid.on: A grid is drawn on this projector, bent by its warps
projectorGrid.off: Draws a grid on this projector, bent by its warps, to set the geometry by

point.title: Point
point.none: Tap a point to pick it. Drag it to move it; sliding the finger away from the line it started along slows it down.

grid.title: Grid
grid.explain: The warp keeps its shape when points are added or taken away.

zone.ownHasNone: The output's own canvas lies whole: only a zone has an opacity and a blend.

prompt.title: Script prompt (Choufleur)
prompt.explain: The address of your Choufleur cue list, as Choufleur's library screen shows it or its code carries it: http://<number>:8080/list/<list>. A host alone is completed to port 8080. Once it is saved, the Script tab shows the page.
prompt.scanPrompt: Aim at the code on Choufleur's screen
prompt.notAnAddress: Not an address: type http://host:port/list/name, or the host alone.
prompt.localName: A .local name is not found on every network or with every Android setting: if the page does not load, use the number Choufleur's screen gives.
prompt.scanNotAddress: The code does not carry a web address: {text}
prompt.cameraRefused: The camera was refused, so the code cannot be scanned: type the address instead.
prompt.buzzer: The wrist buzzer is linked below, under Wrist buzzer: Choufleur's page sends its warnings through the remote.
prompt.awake: The remote keeps the screen awake itself: the page's warning that the screen can sleep does not apply here.
prompt.noBrowser: No browser on this tablet opens {address}.
prompt.failed: The script page did not load from {address}.

problem.connect: Nothing answered at that address: is Choufleur running, and is this tablet on its network?
problem.hostLookup: That name was not found on the network: use the number Choufleur's screen gives.
problem.http: Choufleur answered with an error ({status}): is the list still in the show?

buzzer.title: Wrist buzzer (Choufleur)
buzzer.explain: Choufleur's wrist buzzer, linked by the remote. Choufleur's page in the Script tab sends its warnings through this link; the remote keeps it alive and links it again when it comes back in range.
buzzer.none: No buzzer linked: switch it on near the tablet and look for it.
buzzer.notABuzzer: That wearable does not have the buzzer's service: it is not a Choufleur buzzer.
buzzer.refused: Bluetooth was refused, so the remote cannot look for the buzzer: allow it in Android's settings for the app.
buzzer.pageNote: Choufleur's page shows it under its buzzer button. A Choufleur that does not know the remote yet does not see it: there, Open in Chrome on the Script tab.

folders.title: Show folders
folders.explain: Waveforms fetched from Go.dot, kept on this tablet by show, so they are drawn at once next time.
folders.none: No show folders yet: one is made the first time a waveform is drawn.
folders.forgetText: The waveforms kept for this show are deleted from the tablet. Nothing changes in Go.dot: they are fetched again when they are needed.

running.title: Running
running.notSent: Not sent: no connection is linked
running.hint: Tap a run for its actions · swipe it far either way to kill it
running.loaded: loaded here · GO plays from here
running.dragToSeek: Drag to move the playhead - above or below it for finer steps
running.pillsHint: Tap: skip this round · hold: skip until the group ends
running.over: Over: it leaves this list in a few seconds.
running.killWithMembers: Kill it and everything under it ({count}) - no footer

cues.notGoList: GO fires the GO list's standby, not this list's.
cues.parkOnlyGoList: Only the GO list's standby can be parked from here: make this the GO list first.
cues.noLists: This show has no cue list.
cues.fireNow: Fire now - the standby stays where it is

field.runTrim: Trim of the run playing now - tonight only

inspector.none: Tap a cue to see what the tablet can change on it.
inspector.lockedNote: The show's rows are greyed. EQ, sends, flags and trims still move.
inspector.liveCount: {count} changes ride live - not saved until the show is unlocked and they are kept

cart.about: Each cue of the show's carts is a pad: touch to fire it, out of order - GO never meets a cart. A hold cue plays while your finger is on it.
cart.lockedNote: The show is locked: the pads still play.

surface.standsIn: {surface} is not connected: its strips work from this tablet.
surface.lockedNote: Faders, EQ and sends still move. EQ and sends ride live, not saved until they are kept.
surface.noDca: This show has no DCA, so there is no fader here yet. Every DCA the show has gets a fader on this tablet.
surface.noAim: Nothing is selected. Press SELECT on a strip, or pick a sound playing now.
surface.eqLive: Under the lock the EQ rides live: heard at once, saved only when kept.
surface.sendsLive: Under the lock the sends ride live: heard at once, saved only when kept.
surface.eqHint: A knob turns from where it stands; the further your finger from it, the finer. Press a gain to switch its band in or out, a shape for peak or shelf.
surface.sendsHint: A knob turns from where it stands; the further your finger from it, the finer. Press one to switch its send in or out: its level is kept.
surface.noPlace: None of this cue's sends has a place to set: a pan needs a mono cue into a stereo mix, a balance or a width a stereo cue.
surface.panHint: A knob turns from where it stands; the further your finger from it, the finer. Press a pan or a balance to centre it, a width to swap left and right.
